title: Handles the success and failure of promises respectively
goal: uses then and catch to handle the two results of Promise and supports subsequent retries.
summary: Registrar Query Pickup Window. The demo button triggers two conditions: available and busy respectively.
tasks: monitors #ready and #busy clicks and calls askDesk(true) and askDesk(false) respectively.
After a successful request, display “Please go to window 2”. On rejection, display the error message.

example.note: then receives the success value, catch receives the rejection reason, and can also handle the exception thrown by the previous callback.

hint: The two buttons can share a processing function with different parameters and use the same Promise chain to update the status.
